verdict.rationale: Morph documents pointing any OpenAI SDK at its /v1 base URL, with Kimi K3 served through the standard chat-completions endpoint so existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string. It also serves the Anthropic Messages API natively and documents migrating agents off Anthropic/OpenAI. A community user independently confirms the OpenAI-compatible endpoint worked with a third-party CLI, and the llms.txt probe states it is OpenAI-compatible. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of switching back away from Morph mid-workflow, and documentation of edge-case parity such as tool-calling and streaming fields.
